documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018
Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: ABS Marine Services Limited reported strong financial performance for FY26, driven by fleet expansion, disciplined execution, and cost management, with consolidated total income growing by 75.05% year-on-year and EBITDA increasing significantly. Management highlighted ongoing opportunities in India's maritime sector, supported by initiatives like Maritime India Vision 2030 and favorable demand-supply dynamics for offshore vessels. The company expanded its fleet by inducting the offshore support vessel Artemis and plans further vessel acquisitions while focusing on long-term contracts and operational efficiency. Management remains optimistic about demand from offshore energy and port segments, though acknowledging seasonal factors such as the monsoon. ABS Marine Services Limited published its investor presentation for the half year and year ended March 31, 2026, highlighting consolidated financial figures including a total income of ₹322.64 Cr and a net profit of ₹80.80 Cr for FY26.

guidance.claim: Management expects a 10% increase in turnover from current levels in FY27, assuming all vessels run in the second half.
guidance.quote: As regards the guidance on the top line is concerned, we can expect a 10% increase -- assuming that all the vessels will be running in the second half.

guidance.claim: Management expects the EBITDA margin band of 45% to 50% to continue.
guidance.quote: As regards the EBITDA is concerned, I am sure that currently it is in the band of 45 to 50. I am sure that that will continue.

guidance.claim: Management expects the tax rate for FY27 to be around a maximum of 1.5% to 2%.
guidance.quote: Around maximum of 1.5% to 2% in that range.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market, supported by an aging global fleet and limited new vessel additions, continue to improve utilization levels and charter rates.
demand_outlook.quote: Additionally, favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market, supported by an aging global fleet and limited new vessel additions, continue to improve utilization levels and charter rates across segments.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that ONGC has a 20-vessel tender that is expected to come up anytime soon.
demand_outlook.quote: See, demand is as of -- as we talk now, ONGC is asking for about 20-vessel tender is going to come.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that clients are very much in requirement of their vessels because they are fuel-efficient.
demand_outlook.quote: They are very much in requirement of these vessels because these are very fuel-efficient vessels and they know how we have performed last session.

demand_outlook.claim: Rystad Energy data cited that offshore investments are rising steadily across continents.
demand_outlook.quote: Offshore investments are rising steadily across continents

capex_expansion.claim: During H2 FY26, the company successfully inducted the offshore support vessel Artemis into its owned fleet.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of this strategy, during H2 FY26, we successfully inducted the offshore support vessel, Artemis, into our owned fleet, expanding our vessel ownership portfolio and improving our ability to participate in higher-value offshore projects.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated they spent a total of $15 million for both new vessels, Hades and MPSV.
capex_expansion.quote: Just a moment. We have totally, we have spent about $15 million for both the vessels.

capex_expansion.claim: The company received delivery of offshore vessel AM Passion in April 2025.
capex_expansion.quote:
• Vessel Type: DP2 Specialized Offshore Vessel
• Delivery: Received in April 2025
• Operational Focus: To be deployed for upcoming offshore projects / charter opportunities

margins_costs.claim: On a consolidated basis for FY26, total income stood at INR322.64 crores, EBITDA increased by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores, and EBITDA margin expanded by 1,763 basis points to 47.28%.
margins_costs.quote: On a consolidated basis, total income stood at INR322.64 crores, registering a robust growth of 75.05% year-on-year. EBITDA increased significantly by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores, while the EBITDA margin expanded sharply by 1,763 basis points to 47.28%.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for FY26 rose by 196.45% to INR80.80 crores, with a PAT margin improving by 1,026 basis points to 25.04%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax rose by 196.45% to INR80.80 crores, with a PAT margin improving by 1,026 basis points to 25.04%.

margins_costs.claim: For H2 FY26, consolidated total income stood at INR183.11 crores, EBITDA surged by 164.64% to INR94.23 crores, and EBITDA margin expanded by 1,667 basis points to 51.46%.
margins_costs.quote: During H2 FY26, consolidated total income for the period stood at INR183.11 crores, registering a growth of 78.93% year-on-year. EBITDA surged by 164.64% to INR94.23 crores, while EBITDA margin expanded significantly by 1,667 basis points to 51.46%.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that improved utilization levels, better margin realization, and disciplined cost management contributed to healthy growth in revenue and profitability.
margins_costs.quote: Improved utilization levels, better margin realization, and disciplined cost management have contributed to healthy growth in both revenue and profitability.

orders_capacity.claim: Out of the eight owned vessels, five are on long-term charter, two have just come out of charter, and a third newly acquired vessel is awaiting dry dock.
orders_capacity.quote: Out of the eight vessels that we own, five of them are on long-term charter, three of them -- two of them have just come out of charter, and third one is just we have acquired, so it has to go into the dry dock and then only come out and then only we put her in the market.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates a total of 12 vessels, including four smaller vessels operating on long-term charter as pilot and security boats.
orders_capacity.quote: No, 12 number is correct. The other four vessels are smaller vessels, they are on long-term charter. They are pilot boat and security boat. Four of them, two of them running in Chennai Port and two of them are running in Ennore Port. So, totally we have a, you know, 12 vessels.

orders_capacity.claim: The top 10 clients contribute around 90% of revenue.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that currency exchange rate fluctuations impact the cost of vessel acquisition.
risks_headwinds.quote: The premium is only because of the exchange rate. Other than that, I don't see much change in this because from what we were paying INR82 per dollar, it has gone up to INR96. So, that is playing on the cost of the vessel.

risks_headwinds.claim: Forward-looking statements are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.
risks_headwinds.quote: Such forward-looking statements are not guarantee of future performance and are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they are scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Further enhancing our offshore capabilities, we are also scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated the vision is to expand and add seven to eight vessels over a period of two to three years.
management_commitments.quote: I think Captain has already told that the vision is to expand and to go forward for seven to eight vessels over a period of two to three years.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated a commitment to building a robust asset base that drives operational efficiency, enhances service delivery, and supports sustainable long-term growth.
management_commitments.quote: We stay committed to building a robust asset base that drives operational efficiency, enhances service delivery, and supports sustainable long-term growth.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
